year_policy: Conference publication years where applicable; earlier arXiv dates are not contradictions. IDs are local aliases, not actual OpenAlex IDs. Reference lists are deliberately partial.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.abstract: Introduces the Transformer: attention-based encoder-decoder sequence transduction without recurrent or convolutional layers.
papers.detail: Introduces the Transformer: attention-based encoder-decoder sequence transduction without recurrent or convolutional layers.

papers.title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Uses LSTM encoder-decoder networks to map sequences through a fixed-dimensional representation for translation.
papers.detail: Uses LSTM encoder-decoder networks to map sequences through a fixed-dimensional representation for translation.

papers.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
papers.abstract: Learns soft alignment so a recurrent decoder can use relevant encoder states rather than only a fixed-length vector.
papers.detail: Learns soft alignment so a recurrent decoder can use relevant encoder states rather than only a fixed-length vector.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.abstract: Uses residual functions and identity shortcuts to ease optimization of deep image-recognition networks. Contrasts ungated identity shortcuts with concurrent gated highway networks.
papers.detail: Uses residual functions and identity shortcuts to ease optimization of deep image-recognition networks. Contrasts ungated identity shortcuts with concurrent gated highway networks.

papers.title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
papers.abstract: Studies deeper convolutional image-recognition networks using small 3 by 3 filters.
papers.detail: Studies deeper convolutional image-recognition networks using small 3 by 3 filters.

papers.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
papers.abstract: Normalizes layer inputs using minibatch statistics to improve neural-network training. This is not a residual shortcut mechanism.
papers.detail: Normalizes layer inputs using minibatch statistics to improve neural-network training. This is not a residual shortcut mechanism.

papers.title: Highway Networks
papers.abstract: Uses learned gates to control information flow through deep networks; distinct from ungated identity residual shortcuts.
papers.detail: Uses learned gates to control information flow through deep networks; distinct from ungated identity residual shortcuts.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.abstract: Combines a DPR-initialized dense retriever with a BART sequence generator and external Wikipedia memory. Fine-tunes query encoder and generator while keeping the document encoder fixed.
papers.detail: Combines a DPR-initialized dense retriever with a BART sequence generator and external Wikipedia memory. Fine-tunes query encoder and generator while keeping the document encoder fixed.

papers.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
papers.abstract: Learns dense question and passage representations with a dual encoder for passage retrieval in open-domain question answering.
papers.detail: Learns dense question and passage representations with a dual encoder for passage retrieval in open-domain question answering.

papers.title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training for Natural Language Generation, Translation, and Comprehension
papers.abstract: Pretrains a sequence-to-sequence model to reconstruct text corrupted by noise, combining a bidirectional encoder with an autoregressive decoder.
papers.detail: Pretrains a sequence-to-sequence model to reconstruct text corrupted by noise, combining a bidirectional encoder with an autoregressive decoder.

papers.title: REALM: Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Pre-Training
papers.abstract: Learns retrieval during language-model pretraining and applies it to open-domain question answering; related work rather than the BART generator used by RAG.
papers.detail: Learns retrieval during language-model pretraining and applies it to open-domain question answering; related work rather than the BART generator used by RAG.

transformer.concept: Transformer architecture for neural machine translation
facts: Sequence-to-sequence recurrent translation precedes soft alignment and the Transformer; the Transformer removes recurrence, not the encoder-decoder idea.
Attention Is All You Need cites seq2seq, alignment, and residual learning (references 35, 2, and 11). Residual connections are a supporting architectural ingredient, not the origin of attention.

rag.concept: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
facts: DPR supplies retriever initialization; BART supplies the generator. REALM is related retrieval-augmented pretraining, not the generator.
The RAG paper cites DPR, BART, and REALM (references 26, 32, and 20). Its document encoder remains fixed; it does not guarantee elimination of hallucinations.

resnet.concept: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
facts: Residual learning addresses optimization degradation with residual functions and identity shortcuts; highway networks use gates and are described as concurrent work.
ResNet cites VGG, Batch Normalization, and Highway Networks (references 41, 16, and 42). A citation to concurrent work does not establish that ResNet was derived from it.
